## `node64.certificates`

TLS certificates, certificate authorities and ACME settings.

### `node64.certificates.list` `GET /certs`

```swift
func list() async throws -> [Node64.Certificate]
```

Certificates without private keys, expiring soonest first.

### `node64.certificates.create` `POST /certs`

```swift
func create(_ input: Node64.CertificateCreateInput) async throws -> Node64.Certificate
```

Requests a certificate or issues one with an own CA; it is fetched in the background.

### `node64.certificates.upload` `POST /certs/upload`

```swift
func upload(_ input: Node64.CertificateUploadInput) async throws -> Node64.Certificate
```

Uploads an own certificate as JSON (PEM `cert` and `key`, or `p12`). At most 1 MB.

### `node64.certificates.upload` `POST /certs/upload`

```swift
func upload(certFile: Data, keyFile: Data? = nil, keyPassword: String? = nil) async throws -> Node64.Certificate
```

Uploads an own certificate as `multipart/form-data`.

### `node64.certificates.domains` `GET /certs/domains`

```swift
func domains() async throws -> [String]
```

ipv64 domains of the account (for DNS-01 and as alias targets).

### `node64.certificates.get` `GET /certs/{id}`

```swift
func get(_ id: Int) async throws -> Node64.Certificate
```

One certificate.

### `node64.certificates.update` `PUT /certs/{id}`

```swift
func update(_ id: Int, autoRenew: Bool) async throws -> Node64.Certificate
```

Switches automatic renewal. Fails with 409 for uploaded certificates.

### `node64.certificates.delete` `DELETE /certs/{id}`

```swift
func delete(_ id: Int, force: Bool = false) async throws
```

Deletes a certificate.

### `node64.certificates.renew` `POST /certs/{id}/renew`

```swift
func renew(_ id: Int) async throws -> Node64.Certificate
```

Renews a Let's Encrypt certificate now; it is fetched in the background.

### `node64.certificates.chain` `GET /certs/{id}/chain`

```swift
func chain(_ id: Int) async throws -> String
```

Certificate with chain as PEM text, without the private key.

### `node64.certificates.meta` `GET /certs/{id}/meta`

```swift
func meta(_ id: Int) async throws -> Node64.CertMeta
```

Details of the issued certificate (valid until, fingerprint) for scripts.

### `node64.certificates.bundle` `GET /certs/{id}/bundle`

```swift
func bundle(_ id: Int, format: Node64.CertificateBundleFormat? = nil) async throws -> Data
```

Downloads the certificate as a file.

### `node64.certificates.bundle` `GET /certs/{id}/bundle`

```swift
func bundle(_ id: Int, format: Node64.CertificateBundleFormat? = nil, ifNoneMatch etag: String) async throws -> Node64.CertificateBundleResult
```

Downloads the certificate only if it changed.

### `node64.certificates.p12` `POST /certs/{id}/p12`

```swift
func p12(_ id: Int, password: String, legacy: Bool = false) async throws -> Data
```

PKCS#12 file (`.p12`) protected by a password, for Windows, NAS and routers.

### `node64.certificates.dnsProviders` `GET /certs/dns-providers`

```swift
func dnsProviders() async throws -> [Node64.DNSProvider]
```

DNS providers with their fields.

### `node64.certificates.dnsCheck` `GET /certs/dns-check`

```swift
func dnsCheck() async throws -> Node64.CertDNSCheck
```

Own resolvers of the DNS-01 check. Empty = only the built-in ones (ipv64 name servers directly, public resolvers).

### `node64.certificates.updateDNSCheck` `PUT /certs/dns-check`

```swift
func updateDNSCheck(resolvers: [String]) async throws -> Node64.CertDNSCheck
```

Saves the own resolvers of the DNS-01 check. The list replaces the stored one; an empty list leaves only the built-in ones.

### `node64.certificates.runDNSCheck` `POST /certs/dns-check/run`

```swift
func runDNSCheck() async throws -> Node64.CertDNSCheckResult
```

Tests the DNS-01 check: which ways work from here. Takes at most 30 seconds; one working way is enough. The default request timeout is also 30 seconds, so raise `Configuration.timeoutInterval` for this call.

## `node64.cluster`

Local cluster of nodes.

### `node64.cluster.group` `GET /group`

```swift
func group() async throws -> Node64.ClusterGroup
```

Members with their state, the forwarding node, the open code and the sync switches.

### `node64.cluster.createCode` `POST /group/code`

```swift
func createCode() async throws -> Node64.ClusterCode
```

Creates a pairing code for another node (valid for 10 minutes, once).

### `node64.cluster.discardCode` `DELETE /group/code`

```swift
func discardCode() async throws
```

Discards the open pairing code.

### `node64.cluster.join` `POST /group/join`

```swift
func join(address: String, code: String, selfURL: String? = nil) async throws -> Node64.ClusterGroup
```

Joins a group.

### `node64.cluster.leave` `POST /group/leave`

```swift
func leave() async throws
```

Leaves the group. The other members are informed.

### `node64.cluster.updateMember` `PUT /group/members/{id}`

```swift
func updateMember(_ id: String, url: String) async throws
```

Changes the address of a member. Fails with `404` for an unknown member.

### `node64.cluster.removeMember` `DELETE /group/members/{id}`

```swift
func removeMember(_ id: String) async throws
```

Removes a member from the group. Fails with `502` if that failed.

### `node64.cluster.resumeMember` `POST /group/members/{id}/resume`

```swift
func resumeMember(_ id: String) async throws
```

Resumes a suspended member. The node checks again; if it still does not fit, the member stays suspended.

### `node64.cluster.setSync` `PUT /group/sync`

```swift
func setSync(module: String, item: String? = nil, enabled: Bool) async throws -> Node64.ClusterSyncState
```

Switches the sync of a module or area on or off.

### `node64.cluster.resolveUserConflict` `POST /group/users`

```swift
func resolveUserConflict(uid: String) async throws -> Node64.ClusterUserResolution
```

Chooses which user of a same-named set wins cluster-wide (see `Node64/ClusterGroup/userConflicts`). The other versions of that user are dropped on all nodes.

### `node64.cluster.resolveACMEConflict` `POST /group/acme`

```swift
func resolveACMEConflict(thumbprint: String) async throws -> Node64.ClusterACMEResolution
```

Chooses the ACME account cluster-wide when the nodes have different ones (see `Node64/ClusterGroup/acmeAccounts`). The other ACME accounts are dropped on all nodes.

## `node64.dns64.dhcp`

DHCP server.

### `node64.dns64.dhcp.status` `GET /dns64/dhcp`

```swift
func status() async throws -> JSONValue
```

Switch and state of the DHCP server: `mode`, `role`, `standby` (networks where a reserve node stays silent), `conflicts` (network to other primary nodes serving it), `running`, `docker_bridge` and `state` with networks (usage, errors, leases), recent requests, foreign DHCP servers and counters.

### `node64.dns64.dhcp.setMode` `PUT /dns64/dhcp/mode`

```swift
func setMode(_ mode: Node64.DNS64DHCPMode) async throws -> JSONValue
```

Switches the DHCP server on this node (never cluster-wide). Answers `400` if invalid or for a Docker bridge network.

### `node64.dns64.dhcp.setRole` `PUT /dns64/dhcp/role`

```swift
func setRole(_ role: Node64.DNS64DHCPRole) async throws -> JSONValue
```

Sets the role of this node in the cluster (per node). A `primary` hands out addresses; a `reserve` only answers if no node with the cluster scope "DHCP networks" is reachable and none answered as DHCP server in the last 3 minutes.

### `node64.dns64.dhcp.releaseLease` `DELETE /dns64/dhcp/leases/{scope}/{mac}`

```swift
func releaseLease(scope: Int, mac: String) async throws
```

Releases an assigned address (lease).

### `node64.dns64.dhcp.ipv6` `GET /dns64/dhcp/ipv6`

```swift
func ipv6() async throws -> Node64.DNS64DHCPIPv6State
```

IPv6 DNS via Router Advertisement: settings and state. Per node, never cluster-wide. The node announces itself only as DNS server (RDNSS/DNSSL, router lifetime 0, no prefixes);

### `node64.dns64.dhcp.updateIPv6` `PUT /dns64/dhcp/ipv6`

```swift
func updateIPv6(_ input: Node64.DNS64DHCPIPv6Input) async throws -> JSONValue
```

Configures IPv6 DNS via Router Advertisement. Turning it on needs at least one (at most 8) interface and host networking; the ULA address of the interface is announced, otherwise the global one. Fields left `nil` are not sent. Answers `400` if invalid.

### `node64.dns64.dhcp.probeIPv6` `POST /dns64/dhcp/ipv6/probe`

```swift
func probeIPv6() async throws -> Node64.DNS64DHCPIPv6Probe
```

Asks the network for routers (Router Solicitation, takes 3 s), on the selected interfaces, otherwise on all with IPv6.
